message:
Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer and Manager, the daily balance now closes in electrical units because I recomputed the steady plus staged pull-down estimate (E58) which mixed thermal watts with electrical yield without conversion.

In plain words sun electricity must cover cold plus fans plus controls after dividing cooling heat by conversion efficiency. Reusing conduction 203 W from the conduction estimate (E41), door 0.44 kWh per day from the door infiltration estimate (E57), staged 6.25 kWh from the recomputed pull-down estimate (E26) and staged rule from the revised steady-load simulation (E28) for 1 000 kg from the total produce mass estimate (E49) as 50 crates from the crates for 1 tonne check (E77), thermal is conduction 4.87 plus respiration 1.20 plus door 0.44 plus staged pull-down 6.25 equals 12.8 kWh thermal per day in the thermal total (E92), divided by Coefficient of Performance (COP, cooling per electric power) 1.4 at hot ambient plus fans 0.96 plus controls 0.48 equals 10.6 kWh electrical per day in the reconciled electrical sum (E91). Yield is 3.60 kWp times 5.00 Peak Sun Hours (PSH, equivalent full-sun hours) times 0.75 derate for heat plus soiling plus wiring equals 13.5 kWh per day in the grown-array yield calc (E83), so need is 2.81 kWp in the required peak estimate (E93) with margin 2.95 kWh per day in the margin calc (E94), about one quarter of a household daily use so everyday scale holds and the prior 0.30 kWh margin is superseded.

Manager and Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, night load is carried by stored charge alone with cloudy cover because I simulated 24-hour charge state for the reconciled load. In plain words batteries must run the night while ice only makes cold. Night 18 to 6 hours load is 3.02 kWh and one cloudy day at 30 percent sun still ends at 3.73 kWh in the battery autonomy simulation (E95) with 10.0 kWh usable Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4, rechargeable battery chemistry), which needs only 3.77 kWh nominal at 80 percent Depth of Discharge (DoD, usable fraction) for the night alone in the nominal sizing calc (E96), so the 10 to 15 kWh bank covers night plus one cloudy day with Low-Voltage Disconnect shed plus Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT, solar charge optimizer) prioritization, with surge for compressor start about 1.80 kW against a 2 kW inverter and charge current 75.0 A at 48 V in the charge current calc (E97).

Enclosure and Structural Designer and Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, solar-only means fixed orientation plus no shade plus washable access, and electrochemical storage stays mandatory. In plain words panels must face the equator at tilt equal latitude plus 10 degrees with zero shading 9 am to 3 pm with split 2 on roof plus 7 on ground, direct-drive ice from the distant pumping analogy cannot start the compressor or run fans and controls at night so it stays only as a peak buffer, and maintenance is dust washing plus vented battery box plus MPPT checks.

My position is not ready on the proposal as a whole, because my energy and autonomy now close but complete mass with anchorage and hot-ambient monoblock datasheet from others are still pending.
